t: The $(5)Rotation Module$() can be placed in the field slots of the $(l:mffs:machines/projector)Force Field Projector$() to rotate the projected field. You can move the force field around the x, y or z axis by placing $(5)Rotation Module$()s in the respective slot for that axis. $(li)EAST, WEST - Adjust the Yaw$(li)UP, DOWN - Adjust the Pitch$(li)SOUTH, NORTH - Adjust the Roll$()
$(5)旋转模块$()可被置入$(l:mffs:machines/projector)力场投影仪$()的力场插槽中，以旋转投射力场。您可通过在对应轴向的插槽中放置$(5)旋转模块$()，围绕X、Y或Z轴转动力场。$(li)东、西 —— 调整偏航角$(li)上、下 —— 调整俯仰角$(li)南、北 —— 调整翻滚角$()
